routing_smart_desc: Routes only blocked traffic through the VPN
no_servers_available: No servers available. Connect first to choose a location.
routing_note: Smart Routing uses region-specific rules to automatically send traffic that needs the VPN through Spark. All other traffic goes direct for speed and reliability.
added_sites: Added {count, plural, one {# site} other {# sites}}
unbounded_help_banner: Help others bypass censorship by securely sharing your connection.
unbounded_helping_now: People you are helping right now
unbounded_auto_enable_sub: Turn on automatically when Spark is open.
unbounded_hide_sub: Removes the tab. Re-enable here any time.
unbounded_welcome_body: Unbounded lets your device act as a digital bridge for people living under censorship. When you turn it on, their traffic flows through your internet connection to the open internet.
settings_diagnostics_desc: Helps us fix problems: Spark shares error and performance reports; IP addresses and web addresses are removed. Turning it off also deletes the reports stored on this device. Applies after restart.
unbounded_welcome_risks: Before you begin: the sites and services they reach will see your IP address as the source of that traffic, and the approximate location of each person you help is looked up through a Lantern service so it can be shown on your map. Please consider whether that is safe where you live. Unbounded is entirely optional, and you can turn it off at any time.
unbounded_err_toggle: Couldn't change Unbounded. Please try again.
unbounded_advanced_sub: For networks where automatic setup doesn't work.
unbounded_manual_port_help: If your router won't forward a port automatically, forward one yourself and enter it here.
unbounded_manual_port_cleared: Manual port cleared; Spark will set one up automatically.
